name: search_knowledge_base
description:
Search the local knowledge base: by=content searches file contents (default); by=name finds files by file name, directory, extension, or path fragment.
Content search returns paths plus verbatim snippets; when a snippet is not enough, read the full file with read_knowledge_base_file. Name search returns relative paths. Only mention paths when useful or when the user asks.

query.description: Search terms, the user's question, or — with by=name — a file name, directory, extension, or path fragment.

by.description: content searches contents, name searches paths. Defaults to content.

max_results.description: Optional limit on the number of results.
